hits.issue: The condition `(isIntKey && stringKey == null)` incorrectly checks `stringKey` instead of `intKey`. This breaks the logic for reporting `DoNotMixStringAndIntKeys` and violates the requirement that no existing diagnostic is changed.

The condition was changed from `isIntKey && intKey == null` to `isIntKey && stringKey == null`. This is an unrelated edit and a regression. For int-key types the DoNotMixStringAndIntKeys diagnostic now fires based on stringKey, so it is reported wrongly for valid int-key members and missed for int-key members that have no key. It violates NF1 and C4.
